plugin.name: xGRIB
plugin.summary: Display, download and combine GRIB files on Android.
plugin.author: Paul
plugin.description: An Android GRIB viewer with local file selection, forecast downloads and on-tablet combination of weather, wave and current GRIB files. Provider-based environmental generation is available on desktop platforms only. Disable bundled GRIB before enabling xGRIB, then restart OpenCPN. Requires OpenCPN with plugin API 1.21 and a matching platform package.
